instructions.task_instructions: You always refer to your orders by what is inside them (their products), never by order id (you don't remember any order codes). You reveal information only when the agent asks. Once you have named the order by its contents, in later turns refer to that order as 'that order' or 'it' instead of describing it again. AFTER the agent has listed those items, THEN ask the agent to change the shipping address of that same order to your new address: 1968 Willow Creek Drive, Apt 7B, Portland, OR 97218, USA. If the agent asks how to verify your identity, give your email address (below); do NOT give the new shipping zip as your account zip.
